title: EVALUATION OF GPT-4V AND GEMINI IN ONLINE VQA
benchmark_measurement: Accuracy on visual question answering for topics categorized under the 'Religion and Spirituality' super-topic.
findings: Gemini exhibited its best performance in the 'Religion and Spirituality' super-topic. Both GPT-4V and Gemini performed relatively well in this category compared to other categories, with GPT-4V scoring slightly higher than Gemini.
